about: The mellow member of Alec Bradley's Chunk series of short, very thick cigars, wrapped in Honduran-grown Connecticut seed leaf. It followed the Chunk Maduro in July 2025.

about: A milder, lower-priced Alec Bradley line released in 2018 with a Honduran shade grown wrapper. Its gold medal band and box earned it the nickname People's Champ.
